snippet.title: Godspeed Gunslinger - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Godspeed Gunslinger is a fast-paced run-n-gun action platformer with a heavy emphasis on momentum and speed. Are you a bad enough dude to rocket jump and shotgun blast your way to the top of the TOWER OF THE DYING SUN?

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5148940/Godspeed_Gunslinger/

Made in Godot!
